options.delay.description: Delay in seconds for periodic sampling (ignored in snapshot mode)

options.count.description: Number of periodic samples (0 means run indefinitely until SIGINT)

options.show_arrow.description: Enable page fault change arrow display (option -a)

options.comm_field.description: Get command info from process 'comm' field (option -c)

options.strip_dirname.description: Strip directory basename from command info (option -d)

options.process_list.description: Comma-separated list of process names or PIDs to monitor (option -p)

options.top_mode_change.description: Top mode showing processes by current page fault changes (option -t)

options.top_mode_total.description: Top mode showing processes by total page faults (option -T)
